1.content: Relay Two to Central. Radio check. Signal strength is good. No issues to report.

2.content: Central, this is Relay Five. Heavy rainfall reported in the northern sector. Visibility remains acceptable.

3.content: Relay Four to Central. We've lost contact with the maintenance team at Sector Three. Requesting assistance.

4.content: Relay Two to Central. Supply convoy has cleared the eastern checkpoint. Delivery is complete. Returning to base

5.content: Relay Five to Central. Communications equipment at Sector Four is functioning normally. No faults detected during inspection.

6.content: Relay Three to Central. One member of the maintenance team has been reassigned to the western sector. Replacement personnel will arrive during the next shift.

7.content: Relay Seven to Central. Primary communications relay at Sector Two is experiencing intermittent failures. Secondary relay is operational, but coverage may be reduced.

8.content: Sector Four has completed its scheduled generator rotation with no deviation from the planned sequence.

9.content: Sector Six reports continued operation under secondary supply following an unscheduled interruption earlier in the shift.

10.content: Maintenance Team Four has concluded its inspection at Sector Three and is proceeding to the next assigned location.

11.content: Relay Three confirms the eastern communications post has completed its scheduled inspection with all systems remaining within normal parameters.

12.content: Relay Five confirms the 0200 maintenance check has been completed and the equipment has been returned to normal operation.

13.content: Relay Seven reports reduced coverage following a temporary loss of the primary communications link at Sector Two.

14.content: Yeah, we're through the checkpoint. Tell them we'll be back before the next rotation.

15.content: Wait, I thought you were with us. / No. I've been at the station the whole time. / ...Then who's with you?

16.content: The replacement unit's working fine. We're packing the old one up and sending it back with the morning convoy.

17.content: We're almost back at the checkpoint, so you can let them know we'll be there in a few minutes.

18.content: Station 07 is occupied again. / I know. I can see the light.

20.content: Verin, you there? / Yeah. What's wrong? / Someone's on my frequency. / What are they saying? / Ummm / Isaac? / It knows my name.

21.content: You asked him why you were here. / He didn't answer. / [STATIC] / You thought he was hiding something from you. / He is. / [LONG STATIC] / But not from you. / From himself. / [PAUSE] / He thinks he knows what this place is. / He doesn't. / [STATIC] / He thinks he knows what I am. / He doesn't. / [LONG SILENCE] / Good try Verin.

22.content: Personnel record. / Cyrus Chia, ALIAS: Cypher. / Signals Operator. / National Service completed. / Civilian application received. / [STATIC] / Application reviewed. / Station 07 assignment approved. / [PAUSE] / Assignment approved before application. / [LONG STATIC] / Candidate accepted. / Candidate suitable. / [TRANSMISSION ENDS]

23.content: Six listened. / Six asked the same questions. / [STATIC] / Six had so much potential. / [PAUSE] / You do to. / [LONG STATIC] / Don't worry, Cyrus. / You'll understand soon.

24.content: You said it would stop, Verin / It did. / Then why are we still sending people? / Because the agreement, the agreement isn't finished.

25.content: Cyrus. / You tried. / You really did. / You thought there was a way out. / You thought if you understood the rules, you could break them. / [SHORT STATIC] / But there's a reason this works. / There's a reason I still choose to stay here. / [PAUSE] / You think I don't know they're watching me? / You think I don't know what they're doing? / [STATIC] / Why do you think I stay? / Why do you think I never asked to leave? / [LONG PAUSE] / Nevermind taht. / [STATIC] / Why did you come here? / Why did you keep listening? / Why did you believe Verin? / [PAUSE] / [LONG STATIC] / You think you're Cypher. / [PAUSE] / You're not. / [VERY LONG STATIC] / You were simply the number 7. / I’m sorry it had to come to this. / [TRANSMISSION ENDS]

26.content: Don't worry, Cyrus.[PAUSE] Where you're going... / [SHORT STATIC] / You can see your parents. / [TRANSMISSION ENDS]
